setup: uvicorn app.server:app (one process) on the real service and HydraDB release build, baton end-state graph (3,897 nodes, 27,423 links); 18 users on /route (test issues), 2 on /learn (reserve-pool issues, newest first), 60 s, MacBook, 12 cores
learning_writes: 33 /learn calls: 16 were real learning steps (issues_learned 1700 to 1716), the other 17 were reserve issues already in the graph as gap-filled history, which the service treats as a no-op

single_route_ms.source: results/curve.json meta, baton line, one route at a time

diagnosis: almost all route time is inside HydraDB's algo.MSpaths; one route at a time takes 179 ms median, so 18 routing users queue at about 7 routes per second; the graph is bigger than in the earlier run (2,618 issues against 2,286, because gap filling now pulls in more history), so each path query takes longer
